## Security checklist

- [ ] No real subscription URLs, server UUIDs, passwords, access tokens, or generated Xray configs were added.
- [ ] Logs do not expose private connection details.
- [ ] Tauri permissions and CSP were not widened, or the change is explained below.
- [ ] Proxy/TUN/helper behavior was reviewed if touched.
